description: Use this first when the user asks for pending, claimed, or wallet-balance information; use a settlement tool only after an explicit claim request. Returns a read-only JSON summary of receipt counts, estimated pending AIPOU, prior settlement state, and the farming wallet's on-chain AIPOU balance. It may read Base through the configured RPC, but it never signs or submits a transaction, changes receipts, reveals private keys, or returns full receipt payloads.
name: get_aipou_status
